on_completion: If the run succeeds, continue through the frozen Phase-A protocol and report the scientific result. If it fails, preserve the evidence and stop. Either way report commits and hashes, authorization identity, bundle round-trip, provider/pod lifecycle, stage-by-stage result, actual spend, collected artifacts and teardown confirmation.
